description: This file contains an MSTest unit test class for testing the 'Authenticate' API endpoint of the eShopOnWeb project. It includes test methods to verify login functionality with different credentials.

classes.name: AuthenticateEndpoint
classes.description: A test class for the authentication endpoint, verifying login success and failure scenarios with various credentials.

methods.name: ReturnsExpectedResultGivenCredentials
methods.description: Asynchronous test method that sends a POST request to the authentication API with provided credentials and asserts whether the result matches the expected outcome.
